cue: Think of a {object}. A {object}. Think about a {object}, and everything a {object} could be used for.
sham: Notice your breathing. Notice the sounds in the room, and let your thoughts go wherever they go.
wake: What were you just thinking about? Tell me everything you remember.
notes: Cue text follows Haar Horowitz et al. 2023 (Dormio, 'think of a tree'); sham follows their observe-your-thoughts control. Objects are standard Alternative Uses Task items.
